signals.label: Per-model / per-deployment RED
signals.reason: Per-model RED reads the vLLM engine's per-model_name series; the gateway request log has no model column of its own.

signals.label: Time to first token (TTFT)
signals.reason: TTFT is the vLLM time-to-first-token histogram, read from the cluster's /metrics.

signals.label: Time per output token (TPOT)
signals.reason: TPOT is the vLLM inter-token-latency histogram, read from the cluster's /metrics.

signals.label: KV-cache utilisation
signals.reason: KV-cache occupancy is the vLLM kv_cache_usage gauge, read from the cluster's /metrics.

signals.label: Preemptions
signals.reason: Preemption counts are the vLLM num_preemptions counter, read from the cluster's /metrics.

signals.label: Prefix-cache hit rate
signals.reason: Prefix-cache reuse is the vLLM prefix-cache hit and query counters, read from the cluster's /metrics.

signals.label: Goodput (requests within the latency budget)
signals.reason: Goodput is the share of requests finishing within the 30 s budget, from the vLLM end-to-end latency histogram.
